test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The most frequent medallion composition on a carpet consists of a more or less elaborate motif superimposed on the centre of a patterned field and often complemented with corner pieces, which are typically quardants of the central medallion.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Quardant**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct spelling** of '**Quardant**' according to the English dictionary__ is '**Quadrant**'.
 
• The word '**Quadrant**' means '**an arc of 90° that is one-quarter of a circle**'.
 
• Hence, the **most appropriate** answer is '**Quardant**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of the other options.
 
 
• **Medallion**- a small round piece of metal on a chain that is worn as jewellery around the neck.
 
• **Elaborate**- to give more details about something.
 
• **Complemented**- to go together well with.
